title: The Perfect Guide for Barcelona
text: We had a wonderful experience with Mateous on our Montserrat & Sagrada Familia tour! He was pleasant, knowledgeable, funny, and made us feel like we were touring Barcelona with a family friend. We even had a flat tire, and Mateous was our hero! He calmly put on his “mechanic hat” and fixed the problem himself, saving the day and our tour. He made us feel safe and cared for throughout the entire experience. We would absolutely recommend Mateous to anyone visiting Barcelona!

title: Excellent
text:
We really enjoyed the tour with Joaquin and Vincent.  The tour was very interesting and I’m really glad that Joaquin was driving through Barcelona with all the traffic.  

Vincent provided several suggestions that enhanced our tour, overall.

I would highly recommend this team on your tour of Barcelona.
author: TimNMichigan

title: Great guide with extensive knowledge of the area.
text: The guide (Vincent) and driver (Joaquin) did an excellent job.  It was a long day but they kept it interesting.  Vincent answered of our questions and gave us an excellent resultant recommendation! The van was roomy enough for the six of us.  Great job!
author: Engineer003

title: Familia Sagrada & Monserrat small group tour with hotel pick up 15 November 2026
text: Our tour guide , Mateus (Matt) is the best !! He made contact with us prior to the tour day to confirm the tour with very detailed instructions. He is very punctual, professional, very informative, able to make us laugh and very helpful. He made us very comfortable with the moment that he met us. The tour is amazing . We are glad that there is one like this that is able to compress all the Barcelona highlights that we would like to see in one day considering that our time in Barcelona is very limited. This is a tour that is money well worth it !!!
author: anceng
